description: Machine-readable manifest of how each AI coding agent discovers a l00prite project. Entries with a non-null adapter_template ship a file from templates/adapters/; entries with null adapter_template are covered by a generated file (generated_from) or natively by AGENTS.md. Consumed by scripts/validate-l00prite.js.

vendors.tool: AGENTS.md open standard — OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot coding agent/CLI/VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Jules, Factory, Amp, opencode, Devin, Warp, Roo Code, JetBrains Junie, and others
vendors.notes: Generated per-project in Planning Mode. Keep combined AGENTS.md content well under 32 KiB — OpenAI Codex caps it (project_doc_max_bytes, default 32 KiB) and silently truncates beyond.
Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md. The template's fixed 'l00prite Protocol' section is Claude's adapter; .claude/prompts/ mirrors .l00prite/prompts/ byte-for-byte.

Default context file is GEMINI.md; the adapter @AGENTS.md-imports the full standard file. Users can instead set {"context": {"fileName": ["AGENTS.md", "GEMINI.md"]}} in .gemini/settings.json — l00prite documents that snippet but never ships settings files.
Gemini CLI fork; reads QWEN.md by default and supports the same @file imports and settings override (.qwen/settings.json).

vendors.tool: GitHub Copilot — chat, code review, coding agent, CLI
vendors.notes: The coding agent/CLI/VS Code read AGENTS.md natively; when both files exist, both are used. This adapter covers surfaces that read only copilot-instructions.md, and stays self-sufficient because (a) some surfaces cannot open other files and (b) Zed ranks this file ABOVE AGENTS.md in its first-match priority list.

MDC frontmatter with description + alwaysApply: true — guarantees injection even where AGENTS.md support is disabled. Cursor loads root AGENTS.md alongside .cursor/rules; adapters stay short so double-loading is cheap. .mdc remains supported in Cursor 2.2+ (new rules default to .cursor/rules/<name>/RULE.md folders).

Frontmatter trigger: always_on. Documented limits: ~6,000 characters per rules file, ~12,000 combined; content beyond is silently truncated — the validator warns above 5,500. Newer builds prefer .devin/rules/ with .windsurf/rules/ as a still-read fallback.

Not auto-loaded: users pass --read CONVENTIONS.md --read AGENTS.md or set read: [AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md] in their own .aider.conf.yml. l00prite deliberately ships no .aider.conf.yml — repo-root config silently overrides same-named keys in a user's home config, and common .aider* gitignore patterns would swallow it.

vendors.context_file: .rules (first match wins: .rules, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, AGENT.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md — root only)
vendors.notes: Covered without an adapter: the only file l00prite ships that outranks AGENTS.md in Zed's list is .github/copilot-instructions.md, which is self-sufficient by design.
Reads project-root AGENTS.md natively (preferred over CLAUDE.md); no adapter needed.
